item.title: Tipp All-Ireland winner takes Carlow camogie reins
item.description: Carlow Camogie have appointed former Tipperary hurling star Paul Kelly as their new intermediate manager.

item.title: Donegal launch new jersey
item.description: Donegal have become the latest county to unveil a new jersey design ahead of the 2026 season.

item.title: First anniversary Mass for Jody Gormley
item.description: The first anniversary Mass for Jody Gormley takes place this weekend.

item.title: GAA on TV: Leinster and Munster finals take centre stage
item.description: The live TV action comes from Croke Park and FBD Semple Stadium this weekend where Leinster champions in football and hurling, and Munster champions in football, are set to be crowned.

item.title: Donegal and Limerick spend over €2m on county teams
item.description: Donegal and Limerick have joined Galway and Kerry in spending over €2 million on their county teams this year.

item.title: Ballymacelligot come good in second-half against Buttevant to claim Munster club JFC crown
item.description: Ballymacelligot (Kerry) are Munster club junior football champions after seeing off Buttevant (Cork) by 3-12 to 0-8 in Mallow this afternoon.

item.title: An Ghaeltacht see off Aghabollogue for second Munster club IFC success
item.description: An Ghaeltacht (Kerry) captured their second Munster club intermediate football championship title with a 2-12 to 1-8 win over Aghabollogue (Cork) in Rathkeale this afternoon.

item.title: Watch: Goals help 'Boden past Athy to third Leinster club SFC title
item.description: Ballyboden St Enda's claimed their third Leinster club senior football championship title thanks to a 2-12 to 1-14 win against at Athy at Croke Park.

item.title: Stafford the hero as St Martin's pip Ballyhale Shamrocks to Leinster glory
item.description: Ben Stafford's point in the third minute of injury-time saw St Martin's pull off a remarkable 0-24 to 2-17 victory over Ballyhale Shamrocks this evening at Croke Park to capture their first Leinster club senior hurling championship title.
